gate: Phase 0 — freeze projection / covariance / SH / tile-assignment

computes_eager_once_per_gaussian: eigen radius + getRect tile bbox + tiles_touched (L241-262)

inria_rasterizer_impl_cu.duplicateWithKeys_is: 1 thread per Gaussian; replicates INDEX into tiles_touched tiles (key=tile<<32|depth). Index-only; NO projection/cov/SH recompute.

inria_render_forward_cu.renderCUDA_is: 1 block per 16x16 tile, 1 thread per pixel; reads precomputed xy/conic/color; recomputes ONLY pixel-dependent weight power/alpha = opacity*exp(-0.5*conic.d^2). d=xy-pixel_center is per-pixel => irreducible.

gsplat_projection_ewa.is: 1 thread per Gaussian; computes mean2d/cov2d/conic/depth/radius once (persp/ortho/fisheye_proj).

gsplat_intersect_tile.is: pass1: tiles_per_gauss from precomputed mean2d/conic (tile bbox area). Index generation only.

gsplat_rasterize_to_indices.is: per-pixel kernel; reads precomputed means2d[g]/conics[g]/opacities[g]; recomputes only weight alpha=min(0.999,opacity*expf(-sigma)).

gsplat_from_world_fused.is: ALTERNATIVE fused world-space path (not the canonical benchmark backend). process_logical_batch_gaussians stages iscl_rot (=R*inv(S), the Gaussian-level covariance analog) and scale ONCE per Gaussian into shared/registers; the per-(pixel,gaussian) loop then does ONLY the ray-splat evaluation gro=iscl_rot*(ray_o[p]-xyz), grd=normalize(iscl_rot*ray_d[p]), grayDist, power=-0.5*grayDist, alpha=opac*__expf(power). Inputs ray_o[p]/ray_d[p] are PER-PIXEL => per-visit work is irreducible and is NOT projection/cov/SH recompute. colors/opacities passed in precomputed (SH done once elsewhere).

classification.gaussian_weight_exp: PER_PIXEL_VISIT (irreducible: function of per-pixel offset d)

locked_finding: Projection, covariance (3D+2D), and SH are ALREADY computed exactly once per Gaussian and reused across all tiles/pixels in BOTH the canonical EWA path (preprocessCUDA) AND the alternative fused from-world path (iscl_rot staged once per Gaussian). The only per-(pixel,gaussian) recompute is the Gaussian weight exp(-sigma) [EWA] / the ray-splat evaluation exp(-0.5*grayDist) [from-world], a pure function of per-pixel ray/offset — not shareable. There is NO duplicated projection/cov/SH compute to eliminate.
